name: Kondou Yuki
source:
A member of the Special Rescue Team assigned to the Asakusa Temple Substation of the Nihonbashi Fire Station. He possesses the stamina to commute to work by bicycle every morning from Akihabara's Cocoon. He works a rotation of day shift > night shift > post-shift rest > day off.

[Translated from in-game profile]
